parameters.name: Config
parameters.description: The connection configuration of the MCP Server.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: The name of the MCP Server. The name must be unique at the tenant level. It must start with a lowercase letter and can contain only `a-z`, `0-9`, `_`, and `-`.

parameters.name: VisibilityScope
parameters.description: The visibility scope. The corresponding field is used based on the Visibility value.
